data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I purchased two painterly pillows…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64c29fed706f837cb1152fd5)
I purchased two painterly pillows (Painterly Stripe, Sarah Sherman) and two round velvet "Monroe" pillows in olive. It was a splurge for me, more than $400 for four pillows. I was expecting them to be really great quality and "designer wow." The velvet is ordinary, and the white tag is the ugly type you cannot quite cut off without un-doing the stitching. The striped pillows are also a very "ordinary" fabric, more like "canvas" than something I'd like bare skin touch. Also the color on the pillows is more cream than white (I purchased black/white stripe combo). Super disappointed.

July 13, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 28, 2023

Hi Sonia,

Thank you for your feedback. We're so sorry to hear you are dissatisfied with the quality of your pillows. If you'd like to share any additional feedback or process a return, please reach out to our Customer Experience team at support@luluandgeorgia.com.
